```artifact
Feature: Lab Request Routing and Management

  Scenario: Lab requests are routed to the Laboratory after matching the Patient Pincode
  Given a patient with a valid pincode
  When a lab request is submitted
  Then the lab request should be routed to the Laboratory

  Scenario Outline:
    | Patient Pincode | Lab Request Status | Expected Result |
    | Valid           | Submitted         | Routed to Laboratory |
    | Invalid         | Submitted         | Not Routed to Laboratory |

  Given a patient without a pincode
  When a lab request is submitted
  Then the lab request should not be routed to the Laboratory

  Scenario Outline:
    | Patient Pincode | Lab Request Status | Expected Result |
    | Valid           | Not Submitted      | Routed to Laboratory |
    | Invalid         | Not Submitted      | Not Routed to Laboratory |

  Scenario: Lab personnel make appointments and perform home collection of specimen
  Given a lab personnel with an appointment
  When they perform home collection of specimen
  Then the specimen should be collected

  Scenario Outline:
    | Appointment Status | Specimen Collection | Expected Result |
    | Valid           | Collected          | Collected |
    | Invalid         | Not Collected      | Not Collected |

  Scenario: Patients upload reports to the system
  Given a patient with valid reports
  When they upload reports
  Then the reports should be uploaded successfully

  Scenario Outline:
    | Number of Reports | Report Size | Expected Result |
    | 5              | 1 MB         | Uploaded Successfully |
    | 5              | <1 MB         | Uploaded Successfully |
    | <5              | 1 MB         | Uploaded Successfully |
    | <5              | <1 MB         | Uploaded Successfully |

  Scenario: Patient consultation request is routed to a specialist doctor
  Given a patient with a valid consultation request
  When the request is processed
  Then the request should be routed to a specialist doctor

  Scenario Outline:
    | Consultation Request | Specialist Doctor | Expected Result |
    | Valid           | Assigned          | Routed to Specialist |
    | Invalid         | Not Assigned      | Not Routed to Specialist |

  Scenario: Machine Learning Algorithm assists in disease prediction
  Given a doctor with symptoms
  When the algorithm is used
  Then the algorithm should predict diseases

  Scenario Outline:
    | Symptoms | Predicted Diseases | Expected Result |
    | Valid           | Predicted          | Predicted |
    | Invalid         | Not Predicted      | Not Predicted |

  Scenario: Doctor accepts or modifies the diagnosis
  Given a doctor with a diagnosis
  When the diagnosis is reviewed
  Then the doctor should accept or modify the diagnosis

  Scenario Outline:
    | Diagnosis | Acceptance | Expected Result |
    | Accepted        | Accepted      | Accepted |
    | Modified       | Modified      | Modified |

  Scenario: Doctor performs diagnosis
  Given a doctor with a consultation
  When the diagnosis is performed
  Then the doctor should perform the diagnosis

  Scenario Outline:
    | Consultation | Diagnosis | Expected Result |
    | Valid           | Performed      | Performed |
    | Invalid         | Not Performed | Not Performed |

```
